name: Kanon Kotori
source:
A member of the idol unit merry-melody, also known as merymelo for short. To hide that she has the accent of a country bumpkin (Tohoku dialect), she characterizes herself as someone who doesn't speak when she's acting as an idol. She calls her fellow merry-melody member  [url=/c98250]Tsubasa[/url] "Tsubasa-shan".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
